description: This file defines a Flutter widget called InstagramButton, which is a stateless widget rendering an ElevatedButton that, when pressed, calls a method from the SocialService to open Instagram.

classes.name: InstagramButton
classes.description: A stateless Flutter widget representing an Instagram button that opens Instagram when pressed.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns the widget tree for the InstagramButton, specifically an ElevatedButton with an icon and label.
